description: This file defines utility functions and classes related to security token management, Thunder plugin communication, and plugin activation within a C++ project. It includes mechanisms for retrieving security tokens, checking Thunder security configuration, and interacting with plugin shells.

classes.name: SecurityToken
classes.description: Provides static methods to retrieve and manage security tokens, including checking Thunder security configuration and performing HTTP requests to determine security status.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A dispatchable class that executes a provided std::function<void()> when dispatched, used for asynchronous plugin operations.

methods.name: getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves the security token, caching it for subsequent calls, and checks if Thunder security is configured.

methods.name: writeCurlResponse
methods.description: A callback function for libcurl to write response data into a string.

methods.name: isThunderSecurityConfigured
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to check if Thunder security subsystem is enabled by inspecting the JSON response.
